correctness.rationale: PASS: Fourier transform over a splitting field is invertible because p=char F_q does not divide n. Bilinear product yields exact idempotence equations y_r=y_(2r)y_(-r), and descent condition y_(qr)=y_r^q. On each H_t orbit nonzero coordinate forces whole orbit nonzero; applying at r and -r yields y_(2r)y_(-2r)=1, hence y_(-r)=y_r^-1 and y_(2r)=y_r². Orbit consistency gives cyclic root group μ_N_t (with t|N_t and the rho map well-defined). Frobenius rotates H_t cosets in cycles e_t and forces z^(q^e)=z^rho(h), leaving exactly gcd(N_t,q^e-a_t) nonzero choices plus zero. These roots lie in requisite splitting field by group-order argument. One binary zero-frequency idempotent gives prefactor 2. Independently exhaustively computed coefficient-basis idempotents over F2 at n=3,5,9, obtaining 8,12,80; source check_idempotents.py and check_prime_census.c were inspected. Finite data not substituted for general Fourier proof.

final_claim: For odd n>=3 and finite field F_q with gcd(q,n)=1, number of idempotents of quandle algebra basis e_i e_j=e_(2j-i), zero included, is 2*product_{t|n,t>1}(1+g_t)^{c_t} with d_t=ord_t(2), H_t=<2,-1>, N_t=2^(d_t/2)+1 if -1 in <2>, otherwise 2^d_t-1, e_t=order of qH_t, g_t=gcd(N_t,q^{e_t}-rho_t(q^{e_t})), c_t=phi(t)/(e_t |H_t|), and complete Fourier-orbit/Frobenius parametrization.
